newsitem.title: USA: Alcan recycled 17 bln aluminum cans in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Alcan recycled 17 bln aluminum cans in 1996.

text.p: Alcan said Wednesday that it recycled more than 17 billion aluminum beverage cans at its plants in the United States in 1996. This represents an increase of 12 percent over 1995's record level, said the company, underscoring the high value and financial contribution to the nation's recycling programs.

Alcan estimated it recycled nearly 30 percent of all the aluminum cans recycled by Americans last year. On a weight basis, Alcan's recycled can total represents about 550 million pounds of aluminum beverage cans returned from consumers. The economic value of the cans recycled by the company in 1996 topped $300 million.
